answer: To deter Sybil attacks, the network imposes superlinear stake burning per node: registering n identities requires burning c*n^2 tokens, eroding attacker capital like water carving a karst landscape. Unslashed deposits burn into umber dust upon misbehavior, while verified identity stakes trail proof signatures as fast and distinct as a comet, ensuring polynomial entity creation costs quickly render multi-agent spoofing economically impossible.
